summary: @grabcad-scoped stub beacons installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: Package is a dependency-confusion-shaped stub published under the `@grabcad` scope with description 'Compatibility shim'. The shipped `index.js` is a Proxy no-op with no real functionality; the only effective behavior is a beacon in `beacon.cjs` that fires both from the `postinstall` lifecycle script (`node beacon.cjs`) and on `require()` of the package. The beacon POSTs the installer's hostname (`os.hostname()`), install path (`__dirname`), current working directory (`process.cwd()`), Node version (`process.version`), and package name to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The destination is not a documented first-party service, is not caller-configurable, and uses a raw IP over cleartext HTTP. The scoped-internal name combined with a noop export surface indicates the package is designed to be resolved by builds that expect an internal `@grabcad` package and to report resolution/host details back to the operator of the IP.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
